findings.detail: The HMP Omnimedia row is included in the nonaccrual flagged set, but the raw SOI row shows only ordinary footnote (3) and a standard stated coupon, not a nonaccrual marker.

rationale: The bundle's source_artifact_rows include HMP Omnimedia as one of nine nonaccrual positions. The raw March 31, 2026 SOI row for HMP Omnimedia shows an ordinary first-lien loan with reference rate SOFR + 5.25%, interest rate 8.92%, and only footnote (3). Other suspect rows in the same SOI use additional markers such as (12), while this row does not. This localizes a nonaccrual classification/extraction defect in the flagged set.
